title: Silent Ode

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered, floor-length clerical gown with an open front robe over a columnar underdress, featuring voluminous bell sleeves and a wide, rounded hat, creating a statuesque, asymmetrical drape with a hint of a train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A large, rounded mint-green bonnet with gold filigree trim, worn slightly back, with delicate gold hairpins and a fine chain accent near the ear.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-necked bodice in pale mint silk with a front button placket; voluminous bell sleeves with layered white ruffles and gold embroidered cuffs; an open-front robe with metallic gold botanical embroidery and a pearl-trimmed collar.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Columnar black skirt with gold damask motifs and a central metallic embroidery panel; an open split-front robe with gold-edged hem; black opaque stockings and pointed black heeled boots with gold toe caps.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: An open illuminated hymnbook held in white-gloved hands, with floating musical notes and glowing green leaf motifs drifting around the figure.
